exceptions.reason: Shipped inside @cosmjs/crypto, but the application never signs with a key held in the page: Keplr and Leap sign through the wallet's OfflineSigner (web/src/lib/web3.js passes it to SigningStargateClient.connectWithSigner), and the entry exports only SigningStargateClient, GasPrice and calculateFee. The advisory concerns signing with a local key.
exceptions.resolution: Upgrade @cosmjs/stargate (2026-11-05 isolated trial with 0.39.0: same three exports, 29 packages instead of 38 with no elliptic, axios, bn.js or libsodium, a bundle of 1.38 MB instead of 2.56 MB, npm audit clean). It is a semver-major step on a wallet path, so ship it only after Keplr and Leap are checked in a real browser: connect, sign, reject, broadcast the 1 inj verification transfer and open the transaction (web3.js reads result.code, rawLog, transactionHash and height), then run npm run vendor:build and commit the new bundle, manifest and licence table.
